instruction: Grab the brown bottle and give it a shake.

source.instruction: Grab the brown bottle and give it a shake.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the bottle, which was at x = -12 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.plan: Move left gripper in x and y toward the brown bottle position at roughly (-7, 4, 94).
